title: Rhythm and Rust
logline: A socially anxious robot overcomes its fears on a neon-lit rooftop party with the help of a friendly dancer.
theme: Overcoming self-doubt and finding your rhythm.

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A sleek but slightly rusty robot with expressive LED eyes who is incredibly self-conscious.

characters.name: Nova
characters.one_line_description: A vibrant, neon-accented dancer robot who loves bringing people together.

scenes.title: Wallflower in the Corner
scenes.summary: Bolt stands near the entrance of a bustling rooftop party, clutching an oil drink nervously while watching others dance under neon lights.
scenes.setting: Neon-lit skyscraper rooftop party at night

scenes.title: An Invitation
scenes.summary: Nova, dancing in the center of the crowd, spots Bolt hiding. She smiles and waves him over, gesturing for him to join.

scenes.title: First Clunky Steps
scenes.summary: Bolt steps hesitantly onto the floor. Nova demonstrates a simple side-to-side step. Bolt tries to mimic it, but his gears grind stiffly.

scenes.title: Finding the Beat
scenes.summary: Nova laughs gently and guides his hands. Bolt relaxes, his LED eyes changing from cautious yellow to excited blue as he begins to flow with the music.

scenes.title: The Rooftop Star
scenes.summary: Bolt executes a perfect, glowing spin. The crowd circles around him, cheering. Bolt and Nova share a triumphant high-five under the starlight.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
